research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: GrubMarket is researching methods and systems for intelligently managing and using data in a supply chain, focusing on querying information related to a supply chain company through a graphical user interface. The abstract describes generating responses to natural language prompts about supply chain operations, suggesting work on AI driven data access, analytics, and decision support for food supply chain stakeholders, with R and D centered on intelligent data management and interactive information retrieval.

product_launches.description: GrubMarket introduced GrubAssist AI, an enterprise software suite for wholesalers, distributors, and other food-supply-chain businesses.

press_references.value: GrubMarket Announces Sales AI Agent that Transforms Prospecting and Quote Creation for Food Distributors

product_launches.description: GrubMarket launched its Sales AI Agent, a specialized AI-driven tool for wholesale food distributors that automates territory-based prospect discovery, menu analysis, quote and price sheet generation, and multi-channel proposal delivery, integrated with leading food distribution software or as a standalone solution.

press_references.value: GrubMarket Announces Monitoring AI Agent that Detects and Alerts of Critical Business Issues

product_launches.description: GrubMarket launched a new Monitoring AI Agent within its GrubAssist AI platform to provide proactive monitoring, anomaly detection, and alerting for food supply chain operators across their operational and financial systems.

press_references.value: GrubMarket Launches Reporting AI Agent to Deliver Groundbreaking Automated, Proactive Business Insights

product_launches.description: GrubMarket launched the Reporting AI Agent within its GrubAssist AI platform, providing automated, scheduled business reporting and analysis for food wholesalers and distributors, with industry-aware workflows, email delivery, logs, scheduling, and BI tool integrations.

press_references.value: GrubMarket Expands AI Orders Agent with Multi-Format Document Processor, Automating PDF, Excel, and CSV Order Processing

product_launches.description: GrubMarket launched a major upgrade to its AI Orders Agent, introducing an AI-powered Multi-Format Document Processor that automates order processing from PDF, Excel, and CSV files, improving efficiency for food distributors.

press_references.value: GrubMarket Revolutionizes Food Supply Chain with First-Ever Inventory Management AI Agent

product_launches.description: GrubMarket launched the first Inventory Management AI Agent specifically designed for the food supply chain industry, enhancing automation and efficiency for food wholesalers and distributors.

press_references.value: GrubMarket Named to TIME's List of the TIME100 Companies Industry Leaders

product_launches.description: Over the past year, GrubMarket introduced a new generation of agentic AI solutions, including Inventory Management AI Agent, Reporting AI Agent, and Monitoring AI Agent, to automate workflows for food supply chain businesses.

about_short_description.short_description: GrubMarket is an AI-powered B2B eCommerce business operating in the American food supply chain industry.

product.name: B2B eCommerce
product.description: An online wholesale marketplace connecting food wholesalers and distributors with grocers, restaurants, foodservice operators, schools, government organizations, and other buyers across the U.S. and Canada.

product.name: ERP Software
product.description: AI-powered software for food wholesalers, distributors, brokers, and farmers, covering inventory, warehouse management, accounting, HR, eCommerce, payments, mobile applications, and CSA management.

product.name: Enterprise AI
product.description: AI solutions for food supply chain businesses that provide operational insights, intelligent analysis, voice-powered assistance, and automated extraction of orders from multiple channels.

product.name: Office & Home Delivery
product.description: A delivery service for farm-fresh and locally sourced food ordered online and delivered to households or offices across the United States.
